package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const maximumLearningWorkspaceResponseBytes = 64 << 10

type learningWorkspaceResponse struct {
	Schema         string                                 `json:"schema"`
	ContextVersion *int64                                 `json:"context_version"`
	SelectedPath   *learningWorkspaceSelectedPathResponse `json:"selected_path,omitempty"`
}

type learningWorkspaceSelectedPathResponse struct {
	LearningPathID string                           `json:"learning_path_id"`
	CourseID       string                           `json:"course_id"`
	Status         string                           `json:"status"`
	PathVersion    *int64                           `json:"path_version"`
	Items          *[]learningWorkspaceItemResponse `json:"items"`
}

type learningWorkspaceItemResponse struct {
	ReferenceType string                             `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string                             `json:"reference_id"`
	Position      *int                               `json:"position"`
	Status        domain.LearningWorkspaceItemStatus `json:"status"`
}

func (client Client) GetLearningWorkspace(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	parsedStudentID, err := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	if err != nil || parsedStudentID.String() != studentID {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken(
		"/internal/students/"+url.PathEscape(studentID)+"/learning-workspace",
		client.LearningWorkspaceToken,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	if !studentJSONMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	}
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumLearningWorkspaceResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil || len(contents) > maximumLearningWorkspaceResponseBytes {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	}
	var payload learningWorkspaceResponse
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace)
	}
	workspace, err := payload.domainWorkspace()
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	workspace, err = domain.NormalizeStudentLearningWorkspace(workspace)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, err
	}
	return workspace, nil
}

func (payload learningWorkspaceResponse) domainWorkspace() (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error) {
	if payload.ContextVersion == nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}
	workspace := domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{Schema: payload.Schema, ContextVersion: *payload.ContextVersion}
	if payload.SelectedPath == nil {
		return workspace, nil
	}
	path := payload.SelectedPath
	if path.PathVersion == nil || path.Items == nil || len(*path.Items) < 1 || len(*path.Items) > 500 {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
	}
	items := make([]domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceItem, len(*path.Items))
	for index, item := range *path.Items {
		if item.Position == nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningWorkspace{}, domain.ErrInvalidLearningWorkspace
		}
		items[index] = domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceItem{
			ReferenceType: item.ReferenceType,
			ReferenceID:   item.ReferenceID,
			Position:      *item.Position,
			Status:        item.Status,
		}
	}
	workspace.SelectedPath = &domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSelectedPath{
		LearningPathID: path.LearningPathID,
		CourseID:       path.CourseID,
		Status:         path.Status,
		PathVersion:    *path.PathVersion,
		Items:          items,
	}
	return workspace, nil
}
